description: Paged list of products in one catalog category, by category id or URL slug (see list_categories). Public — no authentication needed. Every product carries the EAN, brand, pack size with its unit (kg for goods sold by weight, ks for goods sold by the piece) and the resulting price_per_unit, plus weight_kg. Prices are EXCLUDING VAT — price_vat_included is false and vat_rate gives the rate in percent. The exact stock quantity is returned only to authenticated customers; anonymous callers get in_stock as a yes/no. Authenticated customers get prices that include their personal discount.
name: list_category_products
title: Products in a category
